programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E13'. Ons herleef dié eeu oue tydskrif se dramatiese en ikoniese stories. Ons besoek die karakters, kenners en joernaliste agter die stories.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E1'. 'n Geweldadige reeksmisdadiger word skokkend genoeg op borg vrygelaat na poging tot verkragting. Ingrid Koch betaal met haar lewe wanneer sy en haar man op hulle plaas aangeval word.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E2'. Kyle Ruiters was van jongs af gefassineerd met reeksmoordenaars. Wanneer hy uiteindelik besluit om Lynette Volschenk te teiken, wonder mens of daar ooit hoop was vir die jong man.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E3'. 'Iewers moet mens tog tot jou sinne kom...' Dit is die gevoel van die regter na die afskuwelike aanval en moord op Natasha Barnard een aand na 'n rusie in 'n kroeg wat geweldadig geraak het.

programme.title: Die Klein Groot Verskil
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Zetske van Pletzen en Dr Mark Opperman bespreek hoe om 'n gesonde leefstyl aan te vul. Hul gesels met gaste Esti en Cheralee oor hulle persoonlike struikelblokke en Zetske leer hoe om gesonde maaltye voor te berei.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Op die oog af het jong mamma Chante Serfontein alles onder beheer, maar onder die oppervlak skuil onsekerhede en innerlike seer. Elana help haar om haar vel én haar hart 'n nuwe lus vir die lewe te gee.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E3'. Kenneth en Joanne Ball is die rentmeesters van die omgewingskat Shi-awela by Bandelierkop in Limpopo. Hulle spits hulself toe op die Amerikaanse mark vir hul jagsafari's, en Nguni's speel ook 'n belangrike rol in veldbestuur.

programme.title: Kelderklas
programme.desc: 'S2/E7'. Vir die laaste episode is JP op sy eie energie aangewese. Hy besoek Overhex-wyne in Worcester, waar hy glo wyn uit die tenk mors.

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S2/E13'. Dis kos met storie en siel! Aneeka begin met 'n lekker maklike boujee slaai, en dan sluit haar ma by haar aan om Ouma se klassieke sticky soya hoender saam te maak.

programme.title: Tydlose Skoonheid
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Gewone mense deel die inspirerende stories van hoe 'n gesonde leefstyl asook Zinplex-produkte hulle gehelp het om ouerword met meer elegansie en moed aan te pak.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Groote Post: Naby Darling in die Wes-Kaap boer die Pentz-familie al vir vier generasies. Hulle het as melkboere begin, maar deesdae maak hulle heerlike wyn.

programme.title: Nisboere
programme.desc: 'S9/E24'. Ons reis die land vol om innoverende landbou-entrepreneurs te ontmoet wat woeker op 'n klein stukkie grond.

programme.title: Afrikaans Is 100 Jaar Groot
programme.desc: Kom beleef Afrikaans is 100 Jaar Groot vanuit die gemak van jou rusbank.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E2'. Gerrit van Zyl bedryf sy Hanzyl Bonsmarastoet op die plaas Struisfontein, suid van Dewetsdorp in die Vrystaat. Hy glo wins begin onder die grond en danksy herlewingslandbou dra sy plaas dubbel soveel beeste as die streeksnorm.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Op die oog af het jong mamma Chante Serfontein alles onder beheer, maar onder die oppervlak skuil onsekerhede en innerlike seer. Elana help haar om haar vel én haar hart 'n nuwe lus vir die lewe te gee.

programme.title: Ghoema Woema
programme.desc: Van die ritme van tradisionele ghoema-tromme tot die piep van skoene op dansvloere - Cape Jazz is eie aan ons land. Dans deur die strate van Kaapstad en leer meer oor dié unieke musiek en dans.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S17/E11'. Ons herleef dié eeu oue tydskrif se dramatiese en ikoniese stories. Ons besoek die karakters, kenners en joernaliste agter die stories.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Ons besoek Babylonstoren saam met die sangeres Anna Davel, waar sy en aanbieder Leon Gropp leer hoe om 'n tuinpartytjie in styl op te stel.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S11/E2'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Hierdie week kook Aneeka herinneringe - met 'n bietjie spice daarby! Dis Oupa se smoortjie, Ouma se breyani en Ma se sterk opinies, soos onthou en gedeel deur haar spesiale gas. In Aneeka se kombuis is daar liefde op elke bord.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Aanbieder Leon Gropp help Pieter en Lotie Koen om hul nuwe huis in te rig met splinternuwe meubels. 'n Tuinstel kry 'n vars voorkoms met poeierbedekking, en Leon vind ook uit watter handige produkte jy nodig het wanneer jy trek.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Die Flink Dinkers daag die Anderdogs uit om te kyk wie is baas. Kom kyk hoe die deelnemers mekaar die stryd aansê in die eerste seisoen van Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek.

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Van bekroonde restaurante en wynplase tot gesellige blyplekke en ryk geskiedenis - ons wys jou alles wat Franschhoek besonders maak. Of jy nou 'n fynproewer, wynliefhebber of avontuurlustige reisiger is - Franschhoek wag op jou!

programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Ontmoet Neil Swart van Belly of the Beast in Kaapstad - 'n restaurant sonder spyskaart waar jy net opdaag en die span jou bederf met verrassende, onvergeetlike disse.

programme.title: Drukkoker
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Tien vreemdelinge - vyf kokke en vyf bestuurders - betree die Drukkoker-restaurant. Ná 'n intense kooksessie moet hulle spanne vorm om mee te ding vir die kans om hul droom-restaurant te bou.

programme.title: Die Liefde Is 'n Snaakse Ding
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Mandri en Schalk speel komedie-kupido en stuur die eerste paartjies op 'n 'date' met 'n kinkel. Sal dié paartjies die liefdespad saam aandurf, of rol die liefdesbal terug dating-poel toe?

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Prologue
programme.desc: Prologue. The first contests on this year's edition of the Dakar took place at the gateway to the city of Bisha, on a terrain with a sequence of sandy tracks.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1. Travelling south from Bisha, the air gets thinner and thinner as the road approaches 1,300 metres. The drop in oxygen levels is barely noticeable, but the landscape is no longer the same.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2A
programme.desc: Stage 2A. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2B
programme.desc: Stage 2B. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3. The riders, drivers and crews dropped down by about 500 metres in altitude and especially had to tackle a beginning to the special that was very rocky, before picking up speed on sandy plateaus for approximately 200 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4. Prior to camping out in Berber tents, the competitors weaved their way around canyons, surged up rocky plateaus and turned on the afterburners on flat sandy expanses.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5. The navigation was tricky on the last part of the special, where taking care of tyres was especially important on the terrain made up of large gravel.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Rest Day
programme.desc: Rest Day. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 6
programme.desc: Stage 6. Clarity of mind was essential to finding the way out of this maze of dunes ranging from white to saffron yellow depending on the angle of the light or the composition of the sand.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 7
programme.desc: Stage 7. The stage dazzled with views of Riyadh Province after rolling out of Al Duwadimi for a wide loop to the south-west of the city, stretching for a shade over 410 km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 8
programme.desc: Stage 8. The day's special took place to the south of the capital, on split routes for the FIM and FIA vehicles, but both over distances of more than 480 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 9
programme.desc: Stage 9. Over a distance of 357 kilometres and at a high pace requiring speedy roadbook reading, the main pitfalls to be concerned about was in regards to navigation.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 10
programme.desc: Stage 10. The field rolled out of Haradh to tackle a road section of more than 500 kilometres on route to the shores of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 11
programme.desc: Stage 11. There was a delay to the start of the stage which incited the bikers to request that the stage be shortened to 152km instead of the original 308km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 12
programme.desc: Stage 12. The 47th edition of the Dakar and the 6th in Saudi Arabia was completed in Shubaytah by 175 vehicles - 77 bikes, 40 Ultimate cars, 1 Stock car, 21 Challengers, 23 SSVs and 13 trucks.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: In summer, children gather at the street corners where Jizo statues stand for lively festivities - people pray for the health and success of their children during this cornerstone of faith.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Today: recommending additional repairs. Wewalage Suneth Priyanka Fernando from Sri Lanka works as a mechanic - in a role play challenge, he recommends additional repairs in the interest of safety.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Takasago Masami generates almost no plastic waste composting instead of plastic bags for food scraps or doing dishes with a cloth instead of a disposable sponge - little ideas that are fun and easy.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: Wang Yuan Wei knows what it's like to feel lost - he now offers children from overseas a safe place to call home where they too can say 'tadaima'.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change The World
programme.desc: Data centres, the engines of our digital age, consume vast energy and drive a surge in CO2 emissions, intensifying climate risks while powering global connectivity.

programme.title: Designer-Less Design
programme.desc: Graphic designer Kikuchi Atsuki is drawn to enamelware that reflects the creators' own instincts - he talks about the appeal of designs made and used by the same person.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet French pastry chef Josselin Rimbod who creates uniquely colourful macarons with local ingredients in Toyama, and German-born Peter Steeger who runs an airfield in Bibai, Hokkaido.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: the Seto Inland Sea.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Disaster training is advancing with digital technology. See how AR/VR technology is helping participants gain realistic experience about the movement of smoke in fires and the risks of a tsunami.

programme.title: Activate Your Japanese
programme.desc: Learn how to make the most of your Japanese skills - watch our drama that features useful communication strategies, our snappy videos about onomatopoeia, and our documentaries on 'senpai' in Japan.

programme.title: Bosai: Be Prepared
programme.desc: Winter Fire Precautions: The fact that Japan is dry in winter greatly increases the risk of fire - we learn tips for preventing fires occurring and how to respond effectively when a fire breaks out.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: 'IMPACTS' uses science and data to convey the reality of climate change. A November series-coinciding with the COP30 summit in Brazil-featured five COP-related shows and an Amazon rainforest special.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: Inami Shishimai is a type of lion dance performed in Toyama Prefecture - adults play the role of the shishi while a child is the shishi-tori, whose job is to pacify the shishi with sacred objects.

programme.title: Herbal Symphony
programme.desc: Discover Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden in Uda - here the natural landscape from 300 years ago is preserved in a botanical time capsule as a sanctuary of local culture and history.

programme.title: Seasoning The Seasons
programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Nun's Seasonal Calendar
programme.desc: Learn about the autumn chrysanthemum festival and the autumnal equinox (shubun) as the nuns enjoy sushi, salad and dumplings made specially for the occasion.

programme.title: Trails To Oishii Tokyo Mini
programme.desc: Somen traditional white noodles that are thin like threads - test out and savour the hidden strength of Japan's ultra-thin somen noodles!

programme.title: One In Every Japanese
programme.desc: 1 in 30 Japanese suffer from mental illness - we follow a woman who finds it hard to do simple tasks due to her illness as she goes to rehabilitation for returning to work.

programme.title: Biz Stream
programme.desc: Rehab Reimagined: From home-made activities to interactive digital technology, this episode focuses on different approaches to physical therapy.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The World Heritage Sites In Japan
programme.desc: A selection of acclaimed programmes from NHK's domestic channels dubbed into English.

programme.title: The Beauty Of Japanese Swords
programme.desc: Admired since ancient times for their beauty, Japanese swords are amazing works of art - this time, one of the 'five greatest swords under heaven': Mikazuki Munechika.

programme.title: Hometown Stories
programme.desc: A farm brings together people with something in common: fear of developing dementia. As they engage in planting and harvesting, staff members observe their actions and help them find a way forward.

programme.title: Satoyama Kitchen
programme.desc: At the Satoyama Kitchen guesthouse in Hida Takayama, chef Nobuko, her cameraman husband Makoto and their cat Tama take us on a tasty journey of local cuisine served with a side of seasonal scenery.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: Niigata is one of Japan's foremost ramen hotspots - let's explore the diversity of the city's beloved ramen dishes!
